ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure is the "Settlement Evolution Map of Jilin Province". Read the figure and answer the following question. <image1> From 1820 to 1990, the settlement density of Jilin Province changed significantly. Among its main influencing factors, what was the factor in terms of transportation conditions?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First look at the figure: the settlement density of Jilin Province in 1820 on the left side was overall relatively low, while the settlement density in 1990 on the right side increased obviously, with more high-density patches, indicating that settlement distribution and density changed significantly. Therefore, the answer is construction of transportation lines.
